description:
Hi, I’m Ruby — and I love digging into everything RV, camping, and off-grid power.
What started as a simple way for my family to travel has turned into a passion for exploring, learning, and sharing what actually works on the road.
On this channel you’ll find:
• honest RV tours & walkthroughs
• camping ideas and real-world trip tips
• RV upgrades, mods, and DIY projects
• lithium batteries, solar & power station testing
• helpful gear reviews (no fluff)
• lessons learned from the road — the good and the “oops” moments
My goal is simple: help you feel more confident with your RV, save money on mistakes, and inspire you to get out there and enjoy the adventure.
Subscribe and come along — let’s go unplugged together. 🚐🔋🌲
